summary: Verified Faz 9 CP5 'Devret' two-mode flow (Kişiye + Şirkete). Backend pytest: 3/3 passed — GET /api/task-transfer-companies (admin lists all), POST /api/tasks/{tid}/transfer-company (sets user_id=null, assignees=[], company_id/name=target, orphaned=true, orphaned_from_company_id=target, category_id unset, prev_assignee_* populated; task appears in /api/orphan-tasks), and RBAC 403 for manager transferring to a foreign company. Frontend: ReassignModal renders both mode buttons (reassign-mode-user + reassign-mode-company), KİŞİYE DEVRET body groups members by company (Test Company A: mgr_test/emp1_test; ŞİRKETSİZ: ahmet) with reassign-pick-{username} buttons, ŞİRKETE DEVRET body shows info banner + reassign-company-select (52 options for admin) + reassign-company-submit. End-to-end Şirkete Devret via UI succeeded — success toast 'Görev Test Company A devredildi — Yarım Kalan İşler havuzunda' appeared, task became orphan+kolsuz and entered /api/orphan-tasks. Reclaim via /api/tasks/{id}/reassign (new_owner_user_id) works to restore ownership.
action_items: SPEC-only mismatch (not a bug): Review request referenced testids task-card-{id}, task-kebab-{id}, task-action-reassign. Actual code uses task-item-{id}, task-menu-{id}, ctx-reassign. If unification is desired, add task-card-{id}/task-kebab-{id} aliases; otherwise update the spec to reflect current testids.

Nice-to-have: Company transfer clears category_id (kolsuz) by design; when an orphan is reclaimed via /reassign, category_id stays null. This is expected per spec but worth flagging so UI can prompt the reclaiming user to pick an iş kolu.
critical_code_review_comments: tasks_router.py transfer_task_to_company: RBAC gate correctly enforces can_view_company for target; 403 message localized ('Bu şirkete devretme yetkiniz yok'). Verified.
ReassignModal.jsx cleanly separates modes with lazy company fetch on mode switch — good pattern.
Test spec drift: testids in review request (task-card, task-kebab, task-action-reassign) don't match implementation. Consider aligning naming or adding backward-compatible aliases.
